name: Boomerang
description:
Boomerang is a digital loyalty platform that lets businesses run stamp cards, points, cashback, membership, and coupon programs through Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. This connector brings your Boomerang account into Claude, so you can manage the whole program conversationally — no dashboard required.
With it, Claude can:
• Issue and update loyalty cards — add or remove points, stamps, visits, rewards, and cashback, set expirations, and redeem coupons
• Create and manage customers across your company network
• Build and edit card templates, including reward tiers, membership tiers, appearance, feedback links, and UTM tracking
• Set up automation workflows with triggers, filters, and actions, and review their run logs
• Manage locations and geo-targeted push, plus white-label branding and custom domains
• For agencies: search sub-accounts and switch context to manage them
Ask things like "issue a stamp card for this customer," "add 50 points to card #1234," "show reward stats for the coffee template," or "create a workflow that emails customers after their fifth visit," and Claude handles it through the Boomerang API.
Ideal for business owners, marketing teams, and agencies who want a faster way to run their loyalty programs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Boomerang to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Boomerang to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.digitalwallet.cards/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Boomerang MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Boomerang lists 90 MCP tools, including activate_workflow, add_amount_to_card, add_feedback_link_to_template, add_membership_tier_to_template, add_point_to_card, add_purchase_to_card, add_reward_tier_to_template, add_reward_to_card, add_scores_to_card, add_stamp_to_card, add_visit_to_card, and connect_external_service.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Boomerang?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Boomerang in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Boomerang requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Boomerang is developed by Boomerangme Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
